findings.description: The Planning Commission was scheduled to vote on 10 September 2026 on two 46-storey variants for 536 Mission Street, an office tower and a mixed office-and-housing tower of 385 apartments, proposed by Lincoln Property Company and McCourt Partners and designed by SOM.

citation.label: San Francisco YIMBY, “Meeting Today For 536 Mission Street, San Francisco,” 10 September 2026

raw.text: The San Francisco Planning Commission is scheduled to vote today on plans for the potential 46-story tower at 536 Mission Street

publish.note: A hearing notice, not an event: the headline says a meeting is happening, and a scheduled vote with no outcome fails the ten-year test. The sale the article mentions is carried by The Registry's finding 2026-09-10-0005. The proposal team is kept in extra.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 536 MISSION ST → parcel 3708098; sf-parcels has blklot 3708098 active, 536–536 MISSION; the 2025 roll records it as commercial misc.

findings.description: Demolition permits have been filed for 2500 Mariposa Street, the SFMTA's Potrero Yard, whose redevelopment with Plenary Group will put a new transit facility under up to 513 homes on the 4.4-acre block. Construction of the transit facility has begun, with the housing to follow. The new building is proposed, not built, so its architects go in extra and nothing goes into the building block.

citation.label: San Francisco YIMBY, “Demolition Permits Filed for 2500 Mariposa Street in San Francisco,” 10 September 2026

raw.text: New demolition permits were filed for the site located at 2500 Mariposa Street in San Francisco
